Scene: behind the title, a few illustrated gadgets float at an angle: a slim tablet, a smartphone, a chunky white power bank with a built-in cable (illustrated, not photos, no logos or text on them). Title: tier 1 (white, thick navy outline) 'ブラックフライデー'; tier 2 = the biggest letters of the whole image, on two lines: 'Xiaomi' and below it '本当に安い5つ', bright yellow with a thick navy outline and a deep 3D shadow; tier 3 ribbon (red) with white text '楽天の公式ショップを全部調べた'.
